mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI exceeds 275.0, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 275.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in monthly payroll employment and decline in the unemployment rate indicates a robust labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a housing starts level above the 12-month moving average signals strong consumer confidence and economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST is above the 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production indicates strengthening supply-side economic activity, which supports corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO is trending upward, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5%, it signals a tight labor market that fuels wage growth and consumer spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent expansion in quarterly real GDP and monthly retail sales indicates robust consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of GDPC1 growth and RSAFS growth fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, an elevated federal funds rate above 0.5% signals aggressive policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS is above 0.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.02.
